headword: {民俗|みんぞく}{芸能|げいのう}

definitions.explanation: Traditional performing arts rooted in local communities and passed down through generations, including folk dances, festival performances, ritual music, and theatrical traditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{民俗|みんぞく}{芸能|げいのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Old folk performing arts survive in this region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{民俗|みんぞく}{芸能|げいのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}→披露：09683_hirou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Folk performing arts were showcased at the festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧、{民俗|みんぞく}{芸能|げいのう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担|にな}い{手|て}→担い手：12786_ninaite⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As depopulation advances, there is a shortage of people to carry on the folk performing arts.

notes:
Combines ⟦{民俗|みんぞく}→民俗：13238_minzoku⟧ (folk customs) and ⟦{芸能|げいのう}→芸能：00061_geinou⟧ (performing arts). Refers to traditional performing arts rooted in local communities, as distinct from classical performing arts like ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧ or ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧ which were historically associated with the aristocracy or warrior class.
